description: Save, load, list or delete named composition schemas. Use it when retaining a UiSchema across sessions or past its 30-minute reference expiry; use schema_render to validate/render it or object_registry to manage object definitions. Returns the selected stored schema, listing or write result. action selects the operation; save/load/delete use name. Every save overwrites that name and increments its version; only the latest is loadable. apply is accepted but ignored: save and delete always write. Full tool JSON schemas are separate MCP resources, not entries in this store. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#schema_store; full schema: oods://schemas/schema_store.input.json.

action.description: Selects the schema-family operation to dispatch.

apply.description: Accepted for bridge dry-run/apply mode parity and ignored: this action behaves the same with or without apply (save and delete always write). Actions: save, load, list, delete.

name.description: Saved schema name in slug format (letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores). Actions: save (required), load (required), delete (required).

schemaRef.description: Reference to an in-memory schema produced by design.compose. Actions: save (required).

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering and discovery. Actions: save, list.

name: schema_store
title: Manage Saved Schemas
